Hi Jenna / Integracorp team,

Quick weekly checkpoint from our side for the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focusing on SDK/API integration, auth, streaming, and tool-calling. Attached is an updated MAP checklist with current owners (MAP-v2-integration-checklist.xlsx). Key asks below:

Summary (what changed since last week)
- SDK: v0.9 build passing unit tests; streaming smoke failures on long polling observed (see notes).
- Auth: we've provisioned a customer-specific OAuth client; Integracorp needs to confirm redirect URIs and provide the cert chain for SAML fallback.
- Tool calling: schema v1.2 agreed; testing harness ready for first pass on Thursday.

Meeting/Next checkpoint: can we do a 30-min sync Thu 16 June at 10am PT?

Action items (owners & P0/P1):
1) Integracorp: share cert chain + SOC2 evidence (Jenna) — due Fri 18 Jun (P0)
2) Redwood (Marissa): run streaming smoketest + attach logs — due Wed 16 Jun (P0)
3) Redwood (Karthik): finalize canary routing for dedicated capacity (doc + rollout plan) — due Mon 21 Jun (P1)
4) Joint: tool-calling end-to-end smoke (integration run) — target Thu 17 Jun (P0)

Risks to flag:
- Streaming regression may block high-concurrency timelines (we'll have prioritized triage).
- Legal/Procurement requested SLA language change — noted but shouldn't affect short-term tests.

Please reply with confirmations or alternate times for the sync. I will update the shared Playbook link once we get certs and the streaming log.

Thanks,

1) Streaming smoketest (owner: Marissa) — scope: reproduce long-poll with SDK v0.9 + tool-calling; collect server-side logs (correlation IDs), client trace. Deliverable: streaming-smoketest.log + CI run URL. Due: Wed 16 Jun EOD.

2) Auth certificate verification (owner: Sean) — I will coordinate with Sean to validate cert chain and SAML fallback. Need Integracorp cert bundle (Jenna) and example SAML metadata if they intend to use SAML. Target: Fri 18 Jun.

3) Canary & routing plan (owner: Karthik) — I'll deliver a short doc describing traffic split, fallback to hosted API, and latency SLO monitors. Target: Mon 21 Jun.

4) Tool-calling E2E harness (owner: Marissa + Eng-team) — schedule a joint run on Thu 17 Jun after our 10am sync. Ensure schema v1.2 is the canonical contract in the shared Drive link.

Acceptance criteria (for close):
- Streaming: stable for 2x concurrent streams at expected payloads for 24h in canary.
- Auth: successful OAuth exchange and optional SAML fallback with cert chain validated.
- Tool-calling: a successful end-to-end request that triggers the external tool and returns structured result within 3s median.

I'll attach the rollout doc to the Playbook link by EOD Mon.

-karthik

Quick status from SDK/streaming side:

- Repro: I reproduced the long-poll failure locally using the repro steps Jenna forwarded. Root cause looks like a race where the streaming handler's keepalive timer is dropped when tool-calling hooks are installed for certain payload shapes.
- Fix & mitigation: I have a patch that reinserts a guarded keepalive and added a retry path for the tool-call ack. Running full CI now (https://ci.redwood.example/runs/3421). Initial smoketest passed for short streams; failing cases for 1MB+ payloads still being investigated.
- Logs: attaching streaming-smoketest.log with correlation IDs and stack traces for the failures.

Plan
- Wed 16 Jun: complete CI run, add instrumentation to canary.
- Thu 17 Jun: E2E tool-calling run with Integracorp after 10am sync.

I'll update the Playbook doc in Drive when CI completes: https://drive.google.com/open?id=abc123-integration-playbook

Marissa Cole
